verified: SAP confirmed an IT security incident and said it detected suspicious activity on GitHub, according to SecurityWeek and BleepingComputer.
unconfirmed: That attackers stole SAP employees' authentication tokens and used them to copy and alter source code rests on DER SPIEGEL reporting and insider sources cited by BleepingComputer; SAP has not confirmed which repositories were affected, whether altered code reached products, how many tokens were involved, or when the activity occurred.

verified: SAP 向 SecurityWeek 确认检测到 GitHub 上的可疑活动，并将其定性为一起网络安全事件；SAP 自身的表态是这一确认的依据。
unconfirmed: 攻击者利用窃取的 SAP 员工认证令牌复制并篡改 GitHub 上的源代码，这一说法目前仅来自《明镜》周刊（DER SPIEGEL）的报道及知情人士转述，SAP 未公开证实；受影响代码的具体范围、是否涉及客户产品、事件时间线以及是否已通知监管机构或客户，现有报道均未说明，也未见独立的第三方取证结论。

titles.en: SAP confirms GitHub incident; report says stolen tokens allowed source-code changes, SecurityWeek reports
titles.zh: SAP 确认 GitHub 安全事件，源代码据报遭复制篡改
